category_title: Students with high mobility and off-task verbalizations during independent work
scenario_title: Circle time instruction on the floor
minimal_context: Kyle is participating in circle time instruction while sitting on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for circle time instruction, let's all sit on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Plays on the floor and moves around.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look up here at the board.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are trying to do our circle time lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Acts wild today, playing and moving all around the floor instead of participating.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for circle time instruction, let's all sit on the floor.

STUDENT: (Plays on the floor and moves around.)

TUTOR: Please look up here at the board.

STUDENT: (Continues moving around on the floor.)

TUTOR: We are trying to do our circle time lesson.

STUDENT: (Acts wild today, playing and moving all around the floor instead of participating.)

context.materials: pressure vest available in the classroom
